questions.questionText: Which one of the following best describes how a social scientist would develop an economic theory?
options: Apply logic to make connections between normative and positive economic concepts
Create a hypothesis and test whether it can predict the behaviour of economic agents
Develop a number of policies and test whether they are successful in the real world
Form a set of value judgements and test whether they are supported by statistical data

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a normative statement? The price of petrol
options: fell in real terms last year.
is affected by supply.
is now too high.
will rise next year.

questions.questionText: A government decides that visitor centres in nature reserves are merit goods and therefore increases their provision. It can be concluded that this decision
options: avoided government failure.
did not have an opportunity cost.
ensured provision of a public good.
involved a normative judgement.

questions.questionText: An economist puts forward a hypothesis, collects evidence to test it, and then accepts, modifies, or rejects the hypothesis. This is an example of
options: a positive policy statement.
economic methodology.
how value judgements influence economic decisions.
normative economics.
does not take into account irrational behaviour.
enables accurate forecasts to be made.
includes a value judgement.
may be true or false.

questions.questionText: Economics is a social science because
options: all economic hypotheses are based on value judgements.
economic policies can only be based on positive analysis.
it involves the study of human behaviour and economic decision making
quantitative data cannot be used to test economic theories.

questions.questionText: ‘Large pay bonuses received by top executives have caused income inequality to increase.’ This statement
options: is an example of a normative statement.
is an example of an hypothesis that can be tested.
shows that income tax is not sufficiently progressive.
shows that the distribution of income is inequitable.

questions.questionText: The table below shows the value of the Gini coefficient for a country between 2012 and 2016. Over the five year period, the government has used progressive taxation to change the distribution of income. Based on the above data, which one of the following is a positive statement?
options: A progressive tax system is the fairest way of correcting income inequality.
Between 2012 and 2016 the distribution of income in the country became more equal.
The Gini coefficient is the best way of measuring changes in the distribution of income.
The government should continue to tax the rich to improve the distribution of income.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statements about the distribution of income must be correct?
options: An unequal distribution of income has to be inequitable
‘The distribution of income is equitable’ is a positive statement
The distribution of income is equitable when everyone has the same income
Whether the distribution of income is equitable is a value judgement

questions.questionText: An economist puts forward a hypothesis which is assessed against evidence. As a result of this, the hypothesis is accepted, rejected or modified. This is an example of
options: how normative but not positive economic statements are tested.
how value judgements influence economic decision making.
the methodology used to test economic theories.
why economics is a social not a natural science.

questions.questionText: Economic decision making and policies are influenced by value judgements because
options: all people are motivated by the desire to maximise their incomes.
economic analysis and decision making is assumed to be based on complete information.
they are based on the same methodology as the natural sciences.
they involve moral and political considerations as well as positive analysis.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statements about the distribution of income must be correct?
options: The distribution of income is equitable when everyone has the same income
‘The distribution of income is equitable’ is a positive statement
An unequal distribution of income is, by definition, inequitable
Whether the distribution of income is equitable depends on a value judgement
